general.description: 30P30N main element and flap (slat removed), SA RANS: M 0.17, alpha 5.5 deg, Re 1.71e6

domain.notes: The 30P30N's main element and flap as deployed (flap 30 deg, gap 1.27 %c), without the slat: a configuration with no published reference, for the generator's robustness and the solver's convergence. A wall spacing of 1.5e-5 gives y+ ~ 1 at this Reynolds number.
